regex.assistantDesc: Define regex patterns to transform messages before sending/receiving
regex.assistantVisualOnly: Visual Only (affects display only, not actual message)
regex.findSkipped: Contains macros, so it can only be checked when it runs.
regex.replaceHint: Use $1 or $<name> for captured text. {{macros}} work too.
regex.trimHint: One per line. These strings are removed from every match before it is replaced in.
regex.markdownOnlyDesc: Changes only what you see in the chat. The stored message and what is sent to the model stay as they were.
regex.promptOnlyDesc: Changes only what is sent to the model. The stored message and the display stay as they were.
regex.runOnEditDesc: Also runs on a message after you edit it.
regex.depthHint: Only messages this far from the end of the chat. The latest message is 0. Leave empty for no limit.
regex.tryHint: Type some sample text to see what this script does to it.
regex.globalDesc: Scripts here apply to every assistant and run before an assistant's own scripts.

sheet.title: Author's note
sheet.noConversation: Send a message first: notes and variables belong to a conversation.
sheet.loadFailed: Could not load this conversation's notes and variables

note.desc: A note for this conversation that is slipped into the prompt every few messages, for example to steer tone or remind the model of a fact.
note.intervalHint: 1 adds it to every request, 0 turns the note off.
note.own: This conversation has its own note settings.
note.followingDefault: Following the defaults for all conversations.
note.savedDefault: Saved as the default for all conversations

vars.desc: Values set by {{setvar}} and {{setglobalvar}}. Changes apply to the next request.
vars.name: Name

worldinfo.globalSettingsDesc: Scan depth, budget, recursion and matching defaults
worldinfo.exportNativeDesc: Keeps the book name, description and on/off switch
worldinfo.exportTavernDesc: A world info file that SillyTavern can import directly
worldinfo.deleteEntryMessage: "{{p1}}" will be removed from the book. This cannot be undone.
worldinfo.keysHint: Separate with commas. Regular expressions are written /pattern/flags.
worldinfo.keysSecondaryHint: Optional extra filter, combined with the keywords by the rule below.
worldinfo.orderHint: Smaller numbers come first in the prompt. When the budget runs short, larger numbers are kept first.
worldinfo.probabilityHint: 100 means it always activates once the keywords match.
worldinfo.scanDepthHint: How many recent messages to search. Empty uses the global setting.
worldinfo.ignoreBudgetDesc: Always included, even when the world info budget is used up.
worldinfo.outletHint: Put {{outlet::name}} in a prompt entry to place this text there.
worldinfo.excludeRecursionDesc: The text of other entries can't activate it during recursion.
worldinfo.preventRecursionDesc: Its text isn't scanned for further keywords.
worldinfo.delayRecursionDesc: Can only activate in a recursion pass, not in the first scan.
worldinfo.groupHint: Entries in the same group compete: only one gets in, chosen by weight. Separate several groups with commas.
worldinfo.groupOverrideDesc: Wins over the other entries of its group.
worldinfo.stickyHint: Stays active this many messages after it triggers.
worldinfo.cooldownHint: Can't trigger again for this many messages after it fires.
worldinfo.delayHint: Only becomes available once the chat has at least this many messages.
worldinfo.setScanDepthHint: How many recent messages are searched for keywords.
worldinfo.setBudgetHint: The share of the context length that activated entries may use.
worldinfo.setMinActivationsHint: Keeps scanning deeper until at least this many entries activate. 0 turns it off. Ignored while a recursion step limit is set.
worldinfo.setMinActivationsDepthHint: 0 means as far back as the chat goes.
worldinfo.setRecursiveDesc: Text of activated entries is scanned for further keywords.
worldinfo.setIncludeNamesDesc: Prefix each scanned message with the speaker's name.
worldinfo.setDefaultDesc: The default for entries that don't set it themselves.
worldinfo.setGroupScoringDesc: In a group, prefer the entries that match more keywords.
worldinfo.activationsTitle: World info used in this reply
worldinfo.activationsHint: The entries that were added to the prompt for this reply.
worldinfo.bookNotFound: This world book does not exist.
worldinfo.deleteBookMessage: "{{p1}}" and all its entries will be removed. This cannot be undone.
worldinfo.emptyEntries: This book has no entries yet

layout.hint: Entries are sent in this order. Grey rows are markers that the app fills in automatically (world info, chat history, memory and tool notes).
layout.deleteMessage: "{{p1}}" and its text will be removed. This cannot be undone.
layout.depthHint: 0 puts it after the latest message, 1 before it, and so on.
layout.orderHint: At the same depth, smaller numbers come first; larger ones sit closer to the latest message.
layout.priorityHint: Entries at the same spot are sent from the highest priority to the lowest.
layout.triggersHint: Leave all unselected to send it every time.
layout.forbidOverridesDesc: Character cards cannot replace this entry with their own text.
layout.contextUnlimitedDesc: All history is sent. Turn off to leave out the oldest messages once the budget below is used up.
layout.responseTokensDesc: Only used to work out how much history fits. It is not the max output setting.
layout.squashDesc: Consecutive system entries are sent as one message, joined by line breaks.
layout.newChatPromptDesc: Sent before the first message. Leave empty to send nothing.
layout.wiFormatDesc: {0} is replaced by the activated entries.
layout.title: Prompt
layout.hintPlain: Entries are sent in this order. Selected prompt library entries and manually selected lorebooks also apply without SillyTavern mode.
layout.gestureHint: Click an entry to edit its content; long-press it (or use the sliders button) for name, role, position and when to send.
layout.markerDesc: Filled in by the app. It can only be switched on or off and moved.
layout.tavernModeDesc: On: use the full layout, character cards, persona, author's note and assembly options. Off: use a simplified layout; selected prompt library entries and manually selected lorebooks still apply. World info above/below the author's note requires this mode and an active note. Other settings are kept but not used.

library.deleteMessage: "{{p1}}" will be removed from the prompt library. Assistants and chats that used it will no longer send it.

characters.title: Characters
characters.empty: No characters yet. Import a character card (PNG, JSON or CHARX) or create one.
characters.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Chats with this character are kept, but they lose the card.
characters.deleteWithBook: Also delete the world book that came with the card
characters.reportBookReused: World book “{{name}}” already exists and is used as it is
characters.reportRegex: The card brings {{count}} regex script(s). They stay off until you allow them.
characters.fieldAlternateGreetings: Alternate greetings (swipe between them in a new chat)
characters.booksHint: Books used only in chats with this character. The one that came with the card is listed first.
characters.bookNoneLeft: Every world book is already added
characters.regexHint: These scripts change text in chats with this character. They were written by the card's author, so look them over before you allow them.
characters.regexNone: This card has no regex scripts.
characters.avatarNotImage: Pick a picture file (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF).
characters.avatarTooLarge: The picture is larger than 8 MB.
characters.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 64 MB.
characters.description: Character cards (PNG, JSON, CHARX): import them, edit them, chat with them.
characters.assets: {{count}} file(s) from the card are kept with it

persona.title: Your persona
persona.name: Name
persona.nameHint: What {{user}} turns into in prompts and in character cards. Empty means "user".
persona.descriptionHint: Who you are in the story. It is sent with every request, where the "Your persona" entry sits in an assistant's prompt layout. {{persona}} gives the same text.
